references.title: Safety and Health Standards — Underground Metal and Nonmetal Mines
key_requirements: Mandatory pre-shift examination of underground workings
Methane monitoring required in all underground coal mines
Ground control plan required — roof support and rib control
Refuge chambers required for deep underground operations
Atmospheric monitoring for oxygen, methane, CO, and H2S

references.reference: ILO Safety and Health in Mines Convention (No. 176)
references.title: International Mining Safety Convention
references.summary: Sets international minimum standards for safety and health in mines. Requires risk assessment, training, inspection, and reporting systems for mining operations.
